construction.source_proof:
CAP-ROW VACANCY TRANSPORT

Take the exact scale-four AP6 N36 source block, 3 by 3 horizontal owners
in four full-height layers. In its top layer, retain both outer rows and
shift the three complete owners of the middle row left by d/2, preserving
all actual frames. Append an alternating-frame owner at the freed right
end. The old row positions (-d,0,d) become (-3d/2,-d/2,d/2), with new
position 3d/2. This is one vacancy propagated through three whole owners.

The four final row owners retain the actual axial contact of the square
source, since their frames alternate. Every unchanged neighboring row
has y-distance d and x-distance at least d/2, so its nearest center has
squared horizontal distance >=5d^2/4>4R^2. Other layers retain full-height
separation. Thus final pair compatibility follows before a host test.
The host walls still constrain each whole owner and must be checked.
For a continuous interpretation, retain an actual common separator for
every old/new pair at both endpoints of the three-owner translation; a
missing common row must not be replaced by separately feasible marginals.

WALL-CLOSED MIXED-AXIS COMPLETION

The all-x half-row pattern is rejected by actual sloping host walls at the
lower three levels. Retain that complete pair-compatible control and its
failed wall rows. For an axial row with positions (-1,0,1,2)d+q, types
(1,0,1,0), all containment inequalities are linear in the ONE row
translation q. Intersect them without discarding any host wall. For the
upper two levels use the x row; for the lower two use the y row. Each
middle level forces a singleton interval, q=-sqrt(3)/2 in R=1 units.
Each outer cap level has a nonzero admissible interval containing -d/2.
The complementary four axis/level choices have exact negative interval
width, hence cannot contain this same four-owner word at scale four.

Move the three original owners of each selected row by its wall-closed q,
retain every other source owner, and append the four right-end owners.
Different layers retain their complete height-H separation. Every old pair
has one common exact separator at both endpoints of the simultaneous row
transports; convexity preserves all old pairs along the complete path.
All host inequalities are also affine and valid at both endpoints. The
new owners are appended at the endpoint, where every old/new and new/new
pair and every host wall is checked. No physical passage from infinity
for the appended owners is claimed or needed for the finite packing.

Preserve the first37 top-only insertion separately. The final40-owner
mixed-axis control supplies additional N37,38,39 records by literal whole
owner deletion, with all surviving native centers and frames unchanged.
The known nominal scale4 already occurs in retained footprint results at
these counts. These are new complete exchange geometries and any certified
numeric gain is classified separately from a nominal improvement.

construction.source_and_cap_return_proof:
WHOLE-LAYER TWO-FRAME RETURN

Start from the independently reviewed AP4/AP6/AP12 square product source:
centers (i*d,j*d,l*H), with d=R(1+cos(pi/n)), full height H, and the two
proper native frames I,Q=diag(1,-1,-1). For every integer level l, choose
one symbol sigma_l in {0,1}. Assign the whole owner at (i,j,l) the frame
t=i+j+sigma_l mod 2. This replaces the registered word sigma_l=l mod 2.

This is an actual source family, not independent optimization of angles.
At one level, every unit horizontal neighbor has opposite type. Both
ordered types and both axial displacements are the exact contact states
already proved by the square source (literal midpoint contact vertices).
Every other planar displacement has norm at least sqrt(2)*d>2R, so the
complete circumdisks separate. Between different levels the whole closed
vertical intervals have disjoint interiors, because the centers differ by
at least H. No equality of the top and bottom polygonal rings is required
for this horizontal-plane separator. These statements apply to every
integer pair, for any two-sided binary word (sigma_l). Thus the full source
is valid, and any finite set of its whole owners is valid simultaneously.

The operation changes the frame of every retained owner in one horizontal
layer together by Q. Its inverse is the same operation. It preserves all
centers and complete vertical intervals; the same-level checkerboard and
all interlayer separators close exactly. It is a discrete remove-and-
replace whole-layer return, not a claimed collision-free rigid rotation
through intermediate orientations. The registered-ring source remains a
separate neutral control. Its full-ring equality is not imposed here.

For a self-host gate s and one common source translation delta*e_z with
0<=delta<=2H, a candidate word (i,j,l,sigma_l) is contained exactly when
all actual host walls satisfy
 a_fz*delta <= s*beta_f-h_{i+j+sigma_l}(a_f)-a_f.(i*d,j*d,l*H).
This is a closed interval, possibly empty. The complete integer bounds
come from contained centroids: |i|,|j|<=floor(sR/d), and
 ceil(-(s-1)/2-2)<=l<=floor((s-1)/2).
At a fixed phase, each layer has exactly two compatible alternatives.
Its largest possible owner count is the larger of their exact contained
counts. Different layers have the same vertical separators, so summing
these maxima is sufficient as well as necessary within this family.
Every tied layer alternative is retained as a factored complete decoder;
we do not identify distinct neutral frame states. All interval endpoints
and all intervening open intervals give the complete phase capacity.

The first bounded test uses only AP4/AP6/AP12 self-host N100 gates against
a fresh public and local-native snapshot. It does not assert global
packing optimality, nor cover layer heights other than the declared H.
Source credit: PingYou Ltd whole-layer return built on the retained
square-product sources. No first-discovery claim for the infinite source.

contribution.method:
PINGYOU STRONGER REPLACEMENT CONSTRUCTIONS — REPLACEMENT

Exactly32 previously submitted cases receive strictly smaller native certificates with physically changed complete packings. This archive adds ZERO new distinct cases. Each native source geometry, its full physical construction, complete predecessor states, and current-main/deployed comparisons have passed independent review.

SUPERSESSIONS.json identifies the prior issue, immutable prior archive and native hash, old and new scales, and physical-geometry comparison for every replacement. Earlier archives remain intact. The requested action is to consider each stronger version in place of the corresponding earlier submission while preserving source attribution, rather than count it as an additional case.

The selected versions use explicit complete-owner constructions and returned boundary geometry. Every selected native file is independently certified for all walls and pairs and passes both official native checkers. Classical source attribution and PingYou Ltd finite-construction credit are preserved. No arbitrary angle search is used.

The per-case certified scale reductions relative to the linked prior native files are recorded in SUPERSESSIONS.json. All selected versions beat every current native certificate, including community records. Cases marked strict_nominal_improvement also beat current nominal/reference values. Cases marked certificate_reduction_at_known_nominal_4 preserve the known ideal value 4 and improve only the native certificate; no novelty of nominal 4 is claimed. Submission or certification is not acceptance.
